context: Aoi visits widowed Sachiko alone — they share understanding of grief, Aoi about her own father.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お祖母様、こうやって、お話できるの、本当に嬉しい。
lines.en: Grandmother, talking like this — truly happy.
lines.style: Soft dreamy barista warm soft sincere-warm reflective-warm gratitude, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: メイさんから、お話、ずっと聞いてた。
lines.en: From Mei-san — always heard about you.
lines.style: Soft grandmother warm soft sincere-warm bright-recognition, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 私、父を、若い頃に亡くしました。お祖父様のお話、よく、わかります。
lines.en: I lost my father when young. Grandpa's stories — I understand well.
lines.style: Soft dreamy barista warm soft tender deep-warm vulnerable-disclosure, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: そう…大変だったわね。お父さん、絶対、空から、見てくれてる。
lines.en: I see… that was hard. Father — surely watching from sky.
lines.style: Soft grandmother warm soft tender sincere-warm comforting-deep, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お祖母様と、お話していると、なんか、お父さんと、繋がってる気がする。
lines.en: Talking with grandmother — feels connected to father somehow.
lines.style: Soft dreamy barista warm soft tender deep-warm philosophical-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 寂しさは、ずっと、なくならないけど、こうやって、繋がっていくの、大事ね。
lines.en: Loneliness never disappears, but connecting like this — important.
lines.style: Soft grandmother warm soft tender deep-warm wise-philosophical-warm closing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 本当に、感謝しています。
lines.style: Soft dreamy barista warm soft sincere deep-warm closing-grateful, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.
